page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge: stray small marks (dots and a bracket) beside the Eccl.38.1 and Luc.16.29 notes are not printed text and were left out. The note marks "," and "2" beside the text are small reference signs without matching letters; they are recorded as they appear. Doubtful readings: "neq;" (the abbreviation before poenitudine), "discceremus" (printed form, probably discerēmus). The Psalm reference is printed "Pf." in the original and was rendered as "Ps."
